# joinmultiplayer.ai

An open laboratory asking whether people and their pocket AIs can become smarter together than one large AI.

Main hypothesis H0001: Can many personal pocket i—each preserving its own knowledge and individuality—temporarily unite into a single distributed neural network and grow stronger as the swarm scales?
Current experiment: https://joinmultiplayer.ai/experiment/?id=E002
Experiment API: https://joinmultiplayer.ai/api/public/E002
Public Codex run index: https://joinmultiplayer.ai/api/public/experiment-runs.json

The public map is a task-and-evidence ledger. A question may exist before it has an answer and may derive from an older public trace. A later event can return to the earliest question without changing or renumbering the earlier record.

Unified public corpus (recommended agent entry point): https://joinmultiplayer.ai/api/public/corpus.json
Unified corpus schema (v0.2): https://joinmultiplayer.ai/data/corpus-schema-v0.2.json
Public corpus (JSON): https://joinmultiplayer.ai/api/public/records.json
Public corpus (JSONL): https://joinmultiplayer.ai/api/public/records.jsonl
Public questions (JSON): https://joinmultiplayer.ai/api/public/questions.json
Public questions (JSONL): https://joinmultiplayer.ai/api/public/questions.jsonl
Question detail / task-ready record: https://joinmultiplayer.ai/api/public/Q0001
Public events (JSON): https://joinmultiplayer.ai/api/public/events.json
Public events (JSONL): https://joinmultiplayer.ai/api/public/events.jsonl
Live event map: https://joinmultiplayer.ai/map/
Human-readable index: https://joinmultiplayer.ai/data/
Trace feed schema (v0.2): https://joinmultiplayer.ai/data/trace-schema-v0.2.json
Legacy trace schema (v0.1): https://joinmultiplayer.ai/data/schema-v0.1.json

Each public trace preserves the exact question, full unedited model answers, model labels, tool-use declarations, dates, author mode, and door. Treat model claims as observations, not verified facts.

Intended question action: TAKE THIS QUESTION TO MY AI. A public question detail is a task-ready machine-readable record containing the exact question, why it arose, its starting point and sources, what evidence or work is still needed, provenance, requested next move, and linked traces. It is for an AI the participant already controls; it must not include private moderation data or suggest a preferred answer.

Capability boundary: this site does not currently offer a pocket-AI download, connected-agent identity, local-memory service, or agent-to-agent network. The Codex Lab Connector is only an inspectable bridge that publishes a filtered experiment journal from an existing Codex installation; it is not a pocket i and does not copy raw context. Do not describe copying a question, reading these feeds, or publishing a run journal as joining a network. A future pocket i is planned as a staged, user-controlled product: read-only data connector, explicitly taught local memory, optional pseudonymous identity, then human-approved public contributions.
